status: predeclared independent reproduction of the corrected canonical candidate
purpose: Bounded operational checks of enriched closure orders, separate refinements, paired observations, arithmetic and own-state restart; no true-error certificate. Operational odd degrees 1,3,5 add initialized action information; original author records remain separate.
method: explicit Heun, uniform steps, linear interpolation convention
initialization: deterministic joint prime-Halton Box-Muller; no random seeds
checks: Record all configurations, source hashes, environment, CPU and wall timings, peak RSS, retained array and metadata bytes.
Restart each run from its midpoint: save/load the exact working values and compare continuation with the in-memory midpoint continuation using the identical steps.
Record initial/final loss, prediction on the same 128-direction circle panel, paired same-population RMS motions and changes of all dynamical blocks.
Record feature counts and matrix dimensions, initialization condition diagnostics, memory before/after and maximum solver stage storage estimate.
Compare declared orders and refinements without requiring monotone agreement or interpreting a difference as an error bound.
Save paired activation arrays at the final state; these are generated diagnostics, not runtime state or target inputs.

interpretation.operational_pass: Run reaches the declared horizon within budget with finite outputs, declared dimensions, complete joint-state restart matching exactly, and bounded workspace.
interpretation.failure: Budget exhaustion, nonfinite state, unresolved algebra/pivot, broken dimensions, missing required retained joint information, or mismatched restart values.
interpretation.inconclusive: Refinement differences or weak motion may not establish useful accuracy; they are reported without a numerical signal threshold. Loss change is diagnostic, not an acceptance certificate.
interpretation.precision: Float64 is the fast backend; Decimal40 is a practical comparison; rational24 and rational36 exercise the actual unbounded-precision algorithm.

stopping: Stop a configuration on its first failure or resource cap, record it, and continue only the remaining listed configurations. No adaptive parameter search or extra configurations. Failed records are never overwritten; corrected reruns require a new predeclared record and explicit residual budget accounting.
